scope.flow: L2TokenReceiverV2::increaseLiquidityCurrentRange interacting with Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager
scope.environment: Solidity smart contract using block.timestamp as deadline
evidence: In the function `L2TokenReceiverV2::increaseLiquidityCurrentRange`, the protocol currently uses `block.timestamp` as the `deadline` argument when interacting with the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager. This effectively **defeats the purpose of the deadline parameter**.

Using `block.timestamp` as the deadline has no protective effect because the timestamp corresponds to the moment the transaction is mined. As a result, the deadline check compares `block.timestamp` against the same value, rendering it a no-op.
Without a proper deadline, pending transactions can be executed maliciously at a later time. For example:
- Malicious actors or MEV bots could execute these delayed transactions at a disadvantage to the original submitter.
